Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O obedient creation
The persistent, the swift
Moving through the stations of decree
Revolving in the orbit of management
I believe in the One who illuminated darkness through you
And clarified obscurities through you
And made you a sign among the signs of His kingdom
And a symbol among the symbols of His authority
And subjected you to increase and decrease
And rising and setting
And illumination and eclipse

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ ذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَهُ مُطِيعٌ
Translation: In all of this, you are obedient to Him
And quick to respond to His will

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَهُ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا دَبَّرَ فِيْ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: Glory be to Him, how amazing is what He has ordained in your affair
And how subtle is what He has designed in your state

Arabic text: جَعَلَكَ مِفْتَاحَ شَهْرٍ حَادِثٍ لِأَمْرٍ حَادِثٍ
Translation: He has made you the key to a new month for a new matter
So I ask Allah, my Lord and your Lord
My Creator and your Creator
My Ordainer and your Ordainer
My Fashioner and your Fashioner

Arabic text: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَكَ هِلاَلَ بَرَكَةٍ لَا تَمْحَقُهَا الْاَيَّامُ
Translation: And to make you a crescent of blessing that the days cannot erase
And of purity that sins cannot defile
A crescent of safety from calamities
And security from evil deeds
A crescent of good fortune with no misfortune in it
And of prosperity with no trouble accompanying it
And of ease unmixed with hardship
And of goodness untainted by evil
A crescent of security and faith
And blessing and benevolence
And peace and submission

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And make us among the most pleased of those upon whom it rises
And the purest of those who look at it
And the happiest of those who worship You in it
And grant us success in it for repentance
And protect us in it from sin
And preserve us in it from committing disobedience to You
And inspire us in it to be thankful for Your blessings
And clothe us in it with the shield of well-being

Arabic text: وَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِاسْتِكْمَالِ طَاعَتِكَ فِيهِ الْمِنَّةَ
Translation: And complete Your favor upon us by perfecting our obedience to You in it
Indeed, You are the Beneficent, the Praiseworthy

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And may Allah bless Muhammad and his pure, purified family
